stem.en: Match each protection below to the Fundamental Right that provides it.

text.en: Expressing opinions, assembling peacefully, moving throughout India
Banning human trafficking, forced work, and hazardous child labour
Professing and practising any faith without discrimination
Minorities preserving their language and running their own institutions
Going straight to the courts when any other right is violated

explanation.en: Each Fundamental Right protects something different: how the law treats you, what you may say and do, protection from exploitation, your faith, and the culture of minorities. The sixth, Constitutional Remedies, lets you go to court to enforce all the others.

hints.en: Ask what each right protects: treatment by the law, personal freedom, protection from exploitation, faith, minority culture, or the way to reach a court.
